overview: ShopNest is a hyperlocal fashion e-commerce platform connecting verified local sellers in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities with young digital shoppers. Features affordable fashion, fast 24–48hr delivery, and seller verification for trust.
features: Hero landing page with fashion lifestyle imagery and CTAs
Product browsing with grid layout, hover zoom, and category/price/rating filters
Product detail page with gallery, reviews, seller info, and verified badge
Seller dashboard with product management, inventory, and earnings
Admin dashboard with seller verification, user management, and revenue analytics
User profile with order history and wishlist
Hyperlocal seller detection via browser geolocation
Role-based access for customers, sellers, and admins
